name: B10-0398/2026 (Verts/ALE) – Deteriorating situation of media freedom and freedom of expression in Hong Kong following the recent arrest of bookseller Leticia Wong and the convictions of Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the deteriorating situation of media freedom and freedom of expression in Hong Kong following the recent arrest of bookseller Leticia Wong and the convictions of Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the release of bookseller Leticia Wong and activists Lee Cheuk-yan, Chow Hang-tung and Albert Ho, and for all charges against them to be dropped. It condemns their prosecutions as politically motivated and asks Hong Kong and China to scrap the national security laws. It also asks European Union countries to watch the trials, give emergency visas to people at risk, and consider sanctions on officials. This is the Parliament's opinion; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament asks Hong Kong and China to release the four named people and drop the charges.
- It asks European Union countries to watch trials, offer emergency visas and consider sanctions.
- It asks European Union countries to suspend extradition treaties with China.
